name: P-015 R-4 real-backend identity UI journey with recovery leg (2026-09-24b): nuqs URL round-trip, read-only provider bindings, a forced real compare-and-swap failure with prior state kept, retry reaching the page over SSE, then switch and rollback each applied on the host
commandBasis: Copied from the launching shell (capability:bash task 0mufw0a4n1re2xw82o3), not reconstructed: VERIFY_TAURI_ISOLATED_DB=1 scripts/verify-tauri-headless.sh -- bash -c 'P015_R4_REAL_BACKEND=1 P015_R4_REAL_RECOVERY=1 TAURI_SURFACE_VERIFY_P015_R4_OUT=<out> node scripts/verify-identities-r4.mjs'; the shell printed START/BLOB lines before and POST_BLOB/R4_DRILL_EXIT/END lines after the headless run.
summary: Closes the grader's R-4 gaps on the REAL backend in one run of the maintained driver (scripts/verify-identities-r4.mjs, P015_R4_REAL_RECOVERY=1) inside verify-tauri-headless.sh with an isolated database. Pointer clicks write identityId and identityTab to the URL; a fresh navigation to the captured URL restores the same identity and the Provider bindings tab. That tab names M3 and exposes 0 control(s), 0 enabled. A concurrent writer held the session row lock until the pointer-clicked Apply's compare-and-swap UPDATE was observed waiting on it (wait_event_type Lock), then committed; the route answered HTTP 409 'changed concurrently'. The launch spec, activation and activation-event count were unchanged, the page showed the failure banner with the prior identity, and Apply stayed enabled. The pointer retry succeeded (HTTP 200), and its identities.surface SSE invalidation reached the page (count 1 -> 5) in the same document. Switch applied at generation 1 (revision 735d9ab904c4); rollback applied at generation 2 (revision 0ecfdd869172). Supersedes docs/evidence/p015-r4-real-backend-operational-2026-09-24b.json (15:35Z run, never bound; source-stale after identity-management.ts a21a5e1b59, 2026-09-24 16:47Z). This 18:50Z run is the first isolated-DB boot after the endpoint-ipc-discovery.ts PAPERCUSP_HOME fix (verifier infrastructure, not an R-4 measured source; the 17:41Z and 17:52Z attempts failed on that mismatch). Also supersedes docs/evidence/p015-r4-real-backend-operational-2026-09-24.json (source-stale after control-anchor.ts 33f6d2eb12, 2026-09-24 12:20Z); this run also supersedes docs/evidence/p015-r4-real-backend-operational-2026-09-23b.json, whose select/review/switch/rollback journey it repeats.

subject.note: A disposable owner seeded in the verifier's isolated database. The UI, the identity-management route, its compare-and-swap, the SSE sync path and the host activation acknowledgement are production code paths, not mocks. sourceBlobs are the blobs that ran; each equals its HEAD blob at build time (the driver was committed by git-sync after the run, in sourceCommits).

assertions.evidence: Steps owned-agent-visible, identity-library-visible, owned-agent-selected, recovery-select-identity and real-select-identity passed. Every transition is a real X11 pointer click on an element scrolled into the viewport (steps with input 'X11 pointer').

nuqs-selection-written (identityId=research-steward) and nuqs-tab-written (identityTab=bindings) after pointer clicks; nuqs-restore-navigate to the captured URL, then nuqs-state-restored-from-url (the identity tablist's selected tab is Provider bindings, the section renders, identityId kept); nuqs-tab-rewritten after clicking Library.
provider-bindings-boundary: the section text names 'Available in M3'; 0 interactive control(s), 0 enabled.
real-review-response: action 'preview', HTTP 200, body ok:true with 103 diff row(s); real-review-diff-visible passed.

forced-failure-response: action 'switch', HTTP 409, body names 'changed concurrently'. blockedSwitch shows the switch's adv_sessions UPDATE waiting (wait_event_type Lock, wait_event transactionid) before the writer committed; the driver's pg_stat_activity predicate selected only a statement containing the CAS clause 'AND launch_spec =' (the recorded query is a 160-char prefix).

forced-failure-prior-state: launchSpecUnchanged=true, activationUnchanged=true, activation events 1 -> 1. forced-failure-banner-prior-identity-kept: the banner reads 'Identity change failed: The session identity changed concurrently', no 'Change requested', and the stack card still shows domain:papercusp-engineer.

forced-failure-controls: Apply identity present and enabled. The pointer retry (real-switch) returned HTTP 200 changed:true; identities.surface SSE invalidations 1 -> 5 (sync-before-retry-switch, sync-after-retry-switch); retry-switch-same-document kept the no-reload marker.

real-switch-change-requested, real-switch-host-ack, real-switch-applied: controlGeneration 1 = controlDeliveredGeneration 1, status 'applied', failure null, applied revision 735d9ab904c4 = switch response revision.

real-rollback-change-requested, real-rollback-host-ack, real-rollback-applied: controlGeneration 2 = controlDeliveredGeneration 2, status 'applied', failure null, revision 0ecfdd869172 differs from the switch.
realBackend=true, syntheticMutationResponses=false; the fetch observer (eval:observe-real-fetch) captured every mutation from the page's own requests.
